service.contactBody: Tell us which product and destination you are considering.

shipping.title: From the studio to you
shipping.intro: Available delivery methods, costs, and the final estimate are shown at checkout for your destination.

sections.optionsBody: Enter your delivery address at checkout to see the methods currently available for your order. The final price is confirmed before payment.
sections.preparingBody: Ready-to-ship and made-to-order products may require different preparation times. Check the product page and order confirmation for the status of each item.
sections.trackingBody: When tracking is available, the carrier link is sent to the email used at checkout after the parcel has been handed over.
sections.dutiesBody: International orders may be subject to local duties or import taxes. Any amount not collected at checkout is determined by the destination country.

returns.metaDescription: Return and order issue guidance for Synarava purchases.
returns.title: A considered return
returns.intro: If something is not right, contact the studio before sending an item back so we can confirm the correct route for your order.

sections.startBody: Email studio@synarava.com with your order number, the product name, and the reason for the request. We will reply with the applicable return instructions.
sections.conditionBody: Keep the product unused, complete, and in its original packaging while the request is reviewed. Items showing wear or missing components may not be eligible.
sections.personalisedBody: Custom, personalised, and made-to-order products may have different return conditions. These are confirmed before the order is produced.
sections.damageBody: Contact us promptly with clear photos of the product and packaging. Do not discard the parcel until the studio confirms the next step.

care.metaDescription: Care and safety guidance for goods selected by Synarava.
care.title: Keep it well
care.intro: Care depends on material and intended use. Always follow the product-specific details first; the guidance below is a general starting point.

sections.jewelryBody: Keep away from perfume, household chemicals, and prolonged moisture. Store products separately and wipe gently with a soft, dry cloth after wear.
sections.petsBody: Inspect fittings and surfaces regularly. Stop use if any part becomes loose, cracked, or damaged. Choose products appropriate for the animal’s size and supervise where stated.
sections.kidsBody: Follow the age guidance and adult-supervision notes on the product page and packaging. Keep small parts away from children below the stated age.
sections.toolsBody: Use protective equipment where appropriate and follow the manufacturer’s instructions. Store sharp tools, small parts, and consumables out of children’s reach.

faq.metaDescription: Answers to common questions about the Synarava shop.
faq.title: Before you choose
faq.intro: Short answers to the practical questions that tend to come up before and after an order.

sections.makerBody: No. Synarava is a curated shop across several departments. Product pages identify the maker or vendor and describe the materials and origin when that information is available.
sections.availabilityTitle: How do I know an option is available?
sections.availabilityBody: Choose the required size, colour, or other option on the product page. Only combinations currently connected to Shopify and in stock can be added to the cart.
sections.paymentBody: The final payment step is handled by the secure checkout connected to the shop. Review the store name, items, total, and delivery address before completing payment.
sections.questionTitle: Can I ask about a product first?
sections.questionBody: Yes. Email studio@synarava.com with the product name or link. For fit, materials, compatibility, or safety questions, ask before ordering.
